title.zh: 元吸引子的完整理论整合

scope.zh: 本会话的元吸引、旧表述校正、共同组织、调节分化与持续修订研究。
scope.en: This conversation’s meta-attractor inquiry, historical reconciliation, common organization, differentiated regulation and continuing revision.

objective.zh: 完成全部获授权的理论整合与必要验证后，将本任务改动提交 main。
objective.en: Complete the authorized theoretical integration and required validation, then commit this task’s changes to main.

premises.zh: 一元关系起点；各实例的实质前提、失败和经验对应公开。规范研究属于同一理论，但不接管其他会话的独立任务。
premises.en: One relational unfolding; disclose instance premises, failures and empirical correspondence. Normativity belongs to the same theory without taking over independently scoped sessions.

completion.zh: 逐项核对原定义、旧数学、共同形成、调节分化、后果修订下一构造方法及候选、实际使用、受支持接续和诊断边界；已完成机制复用，新增证明经 Lean 检查。不是以更多目录或有限演示替代完整整合，也不把无条件自证、任意物理发明或一切经验应用增设为原定义的结论。完成后提交已验证的本任务改动，保护并行工作。
completion.en: Audit the adopted definition, older mathematics, formation, differentiated regulation, consequence-driven construction/candidate revision, actual use, supported continuation and diagnostic boundaries. Reuse completed mechanisms and check new proofs in Lean. Neither more cataloguing nor a finite demonstration substitutes for full integration; unconditional self-certification, arbitrary physical invention and every empirical application are not added as consequences of the definition. Commit verified owned changes after completion, protecting concurrent work.
